raw_segments.text: Casca, I can as well be hanged as tell the manner of it. It was mere foolery, I did not
mark it. I saw Mark Antony offer him a crown, yet Tois not a crown neither. Tois one of
these coronets, and as I told you he put it by once. But for all that to my thinking he
would fain have had it. Then he offered it to him again. Then he put it by again. But
to my thinking he was very loath to lay his fingers off it. And then he offered it the
third time. He put it the third time by. And still as he refuzzed it, the rabblement
hooted and clapped their chopped hands and threw up their sweaty night caps, and uttered
such a deal of stinking breath because Caesar refuzz the crown, that it had almost choked
Caesar for he swooned and fell down at it. And for mine own part I durst not laugh, for
fear of opening my lips and receiving the bad air.
